Article Title: J&K assembly passes resolution seeking urgent restoration of full statehood amid BJP walkout
Article Text:
J&K assembly passes Omar’s statehood resolution amid BJP walkout

NEW DELHI: The Jammu and Kashmir legislative assembly on Monday passed a resolution demanding the urgent restoration of full statehood to the Union Territory, amid strong protests and walkout from BJP legislators.The resolution was moved by chief minister Omar Abdullah and was passed despite opposition from the BJP, the largest opposition party in the assembly.Jammu and Kashmir has remained a Union Territory since the BJP-led Centre abrogated Article 370 in August 2019 and reorganised the erstwhile state into two Union Territories, Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.The BJP opposed the resolution, questioning the manner in which it was allowed by Speaker Abdul Rahim Rather. BJP legislators said the Speaker had permitted the resolution to be taken up in relaxation of the assembly rules.As soon as the assembly proceedings began on Monday, BJP members stood up and protested against the resolution.The opposition party also moved a motion seeking the removal of Speaker Abdul Rahim Rather, alleging that he had allowed the chief minister's resolution in violation of the rules.
Article Summary: The resolution was moved by chief minister Omar Abdullah and was passed despite opposition from the BJP, the largest opposition party in the assembly. Jammu and Kashmir has remained a Union Territory since the BJP-led Centre abrogated Article 370 in August 2019 and reorganised the erstwhile state into two Union Territories.

Article Title: SC asks EC to decide TMC name, symbol dispute between rival factions within 3 months
Article Text:
SC directs EC to settle TMC faction dispute over name, ‘flowers and grass’ symbol

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday directed the Election Commission to decide the dispute between two rival factions of the All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) over the party's name and its “flowers and grass” election symbol within three months.A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana asked both factions to complete their pleadings before the poll panel within four weeks.The court directed the Election Commission to take a final decision on the dispute within three months after the completion of pleadings by both sides.The court passed the order while hearing a plea filed by former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee challenging the EC’s decision to freeze the TMC’s name and “flowers and grass” election symbol.The development comes days after the Election Commission temporarily allotted Mamata Banerjee’s faction the name “Mamata All India Trinamool Congress” and the “football player” symbol. The rival faction was allotted the name “Democratic Trinamool Congress” and the “envelope” symbol.Earlier, in an interim order, the poll panel froze the All India Trinamool Congress name and its “flowers and grass” symbol after recognising a factional dispute within the party.Neither faction can use the original name or symbol until the dispute is finally settled.The temporary arrangement will apply to the upcoming bypolls, with candidates from the two factions contesting under the separate names and symbols allotted by the Commission.The Election Commission has been hearing competing claims over control of the party, its name and election symbol. Both factions have submitted documents and appeared before the Commission during the proceedings.The dispute reached the poll panel after rival groups staked claims to control the TMC. The Commission subsequently sought submissions on issues including organisational control, authorised office-bearers, party assets, the party name and its election symbol.
Article Summary: The Election Commission has been hearing competing claims over control of the party, its name and election symbol. The dispute reached the poll panel after rival groups staked claims to control the TMC. Neither faction can use the original name or symbol until the dispute is finally settled.

Article Title: ‘Will contest at least 150 seats in UP’: Congress discusses alliance talks with SP
Article Text:
SP chief Akhilesh Yadav and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi

NEW DELHI: The Congress will contest at least 150 seats in the Uttar Pradesh assembly elections early next year, a party leader said on Monday, asserting that the Congress is “entitled” to contest half the seats in its alliance with the Samajwadi Party (SP).Seat-sharing talks with the SP are likely to be finalised in October, according to Rajendra Pal Gautam, the Congress’ Uttar Pradesh in-charge.“Seat-sharing will likely be finalised in October. Congress has candidates available to contest all 403 seats. Under the alliance, the Congress is entitled to 50% of the seats. We will not contest fewer than 150 seats,” Gautam told ANI.“For the last two months, Congress has been working on seat-sharing in Uttar Pradesh. Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge, Priyanka Gandhi, KC Venugopal and I are looking after this work,” he added.The Congress and the SP are key constituents of the Opposition INDIA bloc in Uttar Pradesh. The two parties contested the 2024 Lok Sabha elections in the state as alliance partners, winning 43 of the 80 seats. The SP won 37 seats — its best performance in a Lok Sabha election — while the Congress secured six. The BJP, which rules both the Centre and the state, finished second with 33 seats, down from 62 in 2019.The previous SP-Congress alliance in Uttar Pradesh, for the 2017 assembly elections, was less successful. The SP won 47 seats and was voted out of power, while the Congress secured only seven seats.
Article Summary: Seat-sharing talks with the SP are likely to be finalised in October, according to Rajendra Pal Gautam, the Congress’ Uttar Pradesh in-charge. The previous SP- Congress alliance in Uttar Pradesh, for the 2017 assembly elections, was less successful. The SP won 47 seats and was voted out of power.

Article Title: 'Medical fraternity cannot be touched': SC cancels Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre's bail in doctor assault case
Article Text:
SC cancels Mhatre’s bail in doctor assault case, stays Bombay HC order

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The Supreme Court has cancelled the bail granted by the Bombay High Court to Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre, who is accused of assaulting a doctor at a civic hospital. The court also stayed the High Court order granting him bail on a plea filed by the Maharashtra government.While cancelling Mhatre’s bail, the Supreme Court said the message should go “loud and clear” that the medical fraternity cannot be touched.A court in Maharashtra had framed charges against Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre and four others over the assault of doctors, including a female doctor, and nurses at Dombivli’s Shastri Nagar Municipal Hospital following a dispute over the treatment of a pregnant woman on July 6.Mhatre, along with Pramod Nikam, Ramesh Pawar, Akshay Karande and Sadhana Karande, appeared before Fast-Track Court Judge N P Vasade two days after police filed a 1,832-page chargesheet in the case.The accused have been charged under various provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita relating to assault and causing hurt, assaulting or obstructing a public servant, unlawful assembly and rioting, common intention, criminal intimidation and intentional insult, besides offences relating to the dignity or modesty of a woman.They have also been booked under Sections 3 and 4 of the Maharashtra Medical Practitioners Act and Sections 37(1)(3) and 135 of the Maharashtra Police Act for allegedly violating orders imposed to maintain public order.Mhatre had been staying in Goa after the Bombay High Court granted him conditional bail in August. The High Court had directed him to remain outside Maharashtra until the chargesheet was filed and ordered that the trial be fast-tracked for completion within three months.After the chargesheet was filed, the condition ceased to operate, following which Mhatre returned to his residence and appeared before the court earlier this month.
Article Summary: SC cancels Mhatre’s bail in doctor assault case, stays Bombay HC order. Shiv Sena corporator is accused of assaulting a doctor at a civic hospital. The court also stayed the High Court order granting him bail on a plea filed by the Maharashtra government.

Article Title: 12 BJP CMs defend EC amid SIR row, hit back at Rahul Gandhi after poll body's fresh note
Article Text:
BJP CMs Rekha Gupta, Devendra Fadnavis and Yogi Adityanath

What BJP CMs said

Rahul Gandhi’s cryptic post

The controversy

NEW DELHI: A dozen BJP chief ministers held press conferences in their respective states on Sunday, a day after the Election Commission of India (ECI) issued a press release responding to a media report that had claimed a “rift” between Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the two Election Commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi.According to a statement issued by the ruling party, the chief ministers accused Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and his party-led opposition INDIA bloc of “conspiring to defame constitutional institutions."In states where the BJP or its NDA allies are not in power, state BJP presidents or leaders of the opposition from the saffron party addressed media instead.Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis remarked that "no vote was stolen, Rahul Gandhi's mind was stolen." He accused the Lok Sabha leader of opposition of "seeking to spread anarchy by defaming institutions" while claiming to defend the Constitution.Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath accused the opposition parties of creating "confusion" over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. In Assam, Himanta Biswa Sarma described the INDIA bloc as an “alliance of losers,” while Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary argued that "cleansing" the voter list was necessary because “booth capturing no longer works in the country.”West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari pointed to the Congress’s support for the SIR in Keralam, where it won, and its opposition to the exercise in Bengal after losing the election.Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami objected to what he described as an "attempt to defame institutions by presenting a note from an internal discussion as a final decision.”Rajasthan chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma questioned why the Congress had not "verified the facts" before making serious allegations over the June 24, 2025, orders concerning the nationwide SIR, which he maintained were adopted by the ECI full consensus of the CEC and the election commissioners.Chhattisgarh's Vishnu Deo Sai accused the Congress of resorting to “anti-national” conduct after “having lost more than 100 elections.” Referring to the Election Commissioners’ joint statement, accompanied by a photograph of the three officials seated at a table, Sai argued that it had exposed what he called a “conspiracy to tarnish the country’s image.”Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta, where a third of the electorate was removed and a third of those remaining received notices as part of the ongoing revision, framed the Opposition’s position on the issue as an attempt to “divert attention from its failures."Rahul Gandhi, meanwhile, posted cryptically on X: “I love swimming in the sea when it’s rough. It teaches you that rough is just another kind of calm.”At a press conference on September 24, a day after The Indian Express published its report, the Congress leader claimed his “vote chori” (vote theft) allegation stood “vindicated.” The Raebareli MP also demanded that CEC Gyanesh Kumar resign or be removed, accusing him of “treason.”The Indian Express reported on September 23 that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had objected to at least 14 decisions over 10 months concerning the ongoing SIR exercise and related matters.The ECI has not disputed that objections were raised; however it characterised them as "disagreements" that were subsequently resolved, stressing that the final decisions were "unanimous." While Sandhu and Joshi are yet to speak to the media, the poll panel's press note second statement outlined several measures and clarifications.The BJP has maintained that the ECI’s press notes have “settled the matter”. Its allies, who, like the opposition, had sought an explanation from the poll body, also welcomed the commission's statement.
Article Summary: A dozen BJP chief ministers held press conferences in their respective states on Sunday. The chief ministers accused Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and his party-led opposition INDIA bloc of “conspiring to defame constitutional institutions” In states where the BJP or its NDA allies are not in power, state BJP presidents or leaders of the opposition from the saffron party addressed media instead.

Article Title: ‘May Allah book his ticket’: Humayun Kabir’s remark on CM Suvendu sparks BJP ire
Article Text:
Humayun Kabir targets Suvendu, BJP reacts

NEW DELHI: A fresh political row broke out in West Bengal on Sunday after Aam Janata Unnayan Party (AJUP) founder Humayun Kabir made remarks wishing for the “early departure” of chief minister Suvendu Adhikari from the world, referring to political leaders who were assassinated or died in accidents.Speaking to reporters in Murshidabad, Kabir said he would pray that the "almighty should book his ticket" and referred to the fate of former prime ministers Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi, among other political figures.“I will pray to the Almighty that he leaves the world as soon as possible. May Allah book his ticket. There will be an end to arrogance,” Kabir said.The Nowda MLA also mentioned former Maharashtra deputy chief minister Ajit Pawar and Congress leader Madhavrao Scindia while talking about political leaders who died unnatural deaths.Kabir said he wanted Suvendu to stop being chief minister and become a former CM. He accused the BJP leader of becoming “arrogant” after coming to power and alleged that minorities were facing harassment under his government.The remarks came ahead of the October 6 bypoll in Rejinagar, the seat Kabir vacated after retaining Nowda in the 2026 assembly elections.The BJP strongly condemned Kabir's comments. Health minister Shardwat Mukhopadhyay said political differences could not justify wishing death for an opponent.“Political courtesy in Bengal has fallen to a very low level. I could not imagine that someone could say something like this so shamelessly. He may not like Suvendu Adhikari or may disagree with his policies, but can anyone wish for someone’s death? I strongly condemn this,” Mukhopadhyay said.Defending CM Suvendu's mandate, Mukhopadhyay said: “Suvendu was not made the chief minister through anyone’s favour; the people made him chief minister”.He added: “Humayun Kabir should remember - a curse does not kill a cow.”Kabir's remarks have added a personal edge to the contest in Rejinagar, where his political influence is being tested after he gave up the seat.Kabir has moved between the Congress, Trinamool Congress and BJP before returning to the TMC and later forming his own political outfit. He won both Rejinagar and Nowda in the 2026 assembly elections but retained Nowda, leaving Rejinagar vacant.The BJP has fielded Sakharav Sarkar, while the TMC has nominated Rabiul Alam Chowdhury. Rebel TMC leader Ritabrata Banerjee's faction has fielded Safiuzzaman Sheikh. The Congress candidate is Mohammad Abdullahil Kafi and the CPM has nominated Syed Asad Ali. Kabir's AJUP has fielded his son, Ghulam Nabi Azad.Rejinagar is a significant constituency in Murshidabad, which has a large Muslim population. Kabir's AJUP won the seat in the 2026 assembly elections, when he defeated BJP candidate Bapan Ghosh by a substantial margin.Kabir and Suvendu have also clashed repeatedly over political activities in the area. Kabir has previously warned against Suvendu's political activities in his constituency, while the chief minister has responded to his attacks.The latest remarks have taken their confrontation beyond political disagreements, with Kabir's references to the deaths of political leaders drawing a strong response from the BJP.The Rejinagar and Nandigram bypolls are scheduled for October 6, with counting set for October 9. The contests are being closely watched amid political realignments following the 2026 assembly elections.
Article Summary: Humayun Kabir says he will pray that chief minister Suvendu Adhikari "leaves the world as soon as possible" Kabir's remarks come ahead of the October 6 bypoll in Rejinagar, the seat Kabir vacated after retaining Nowda in the 2026 assembly elections. The BJP has strongly condemned the comments.

Article Title: 'Wrong message to society': Rijiju attacks Rahul Gandhi over Gyanesh Kumar resignation demand
Article Text:
Rahul Gandhi had alleged that the 2024 Lok Sabha and assembly elections were “all rigged”.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Union minister Kiren Rijiju on Sunday attacked leader of opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi over his criticism of the Election Commission and demand for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, saying such remarks would send a “wrong message to society”.Speaking to reporters, Rijiju said, “It is not appropriate to amplify Rahul Gandhi's remarks in the public sphere, as it would send the wrong message to society.”His remarks came days after Rahul Gandhi stepped up his attack on the Centre and the Election Commission over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Rahul had alleged that the 2024 Lok Sabha and assembly elections were “all rigged” and demanded the immediate resignation of Gyanesh Kumar.Addressing a press conference at the Congress headquarters on Thursday, the Congress leader accused the Election Commission of failing to protect voters’ rights and alleged that the electoral process had been compromised.“Mr Gyanesh Kumar must resign immediately. We are not going to let democracy be destroyed in India and sit silent, and the people responsible for this are going to be punished,” the Rae Bareli MP said.Rahul also referred to reports that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had formally raised objections on several occasions over decisions related to electoral-roll management and the SIR exercise.“The two Election Commissioners have done a wise thing, and I appreciate it,” he said. Rahul further alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union home minister Amit Shah were “at the top of this conspiracy” and would be investigated. He also said Kumar should “turn approver”.“I can say with certainty that Indian elections -- 2024 Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha polls -- were all rigged,” Rahul said. He also linked his allegations over electoral rolls to the functioning of Parliament and other institutions.“From vote chori (vote theft), comes kanoon chori (law theft) and from that comes sanstha chori (institutional theft),” he said.The Election Commission has rejected the suggestion that the reported objections reflected a disagreement over its final decisions.The poll panel said on Saturday that key decisions related to the SIR, including orders and schedules, were taken with the “unanimous approval” of all three commissioners.It also clarified that a letter sent to the Cabinet Secretary, which had drawn scrutiny, concerned the functioning of an officer on deputation to the ECI and was not related to any policy matter, ANI reported.The clarification came after an Indian Express report said that Sandhu and Joshi had formally raised objections at least 14 times over 10 months on issues including voter registration, deletion and restoration of names, changes to Form 6 and access to electoral-roll databases.The ECI said the SIR order issued on June 24, 2025, covering all states and Union territories, was approved unanimously. It also said the schedules for subsequent phases were issued with the unanimous approval of the Commission.Earlier in the day, Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath also criticised the Congress and its allies over their attacks on the Election Commission and the SIR.“Congress and its allies should apologise to the constitutional institutions of the country and to the people for their actions,” Adityanath said.He said the SIR was not being conducted for the first time and pointed to earlier exercises carried out in 1952, 1957, 1961, 1965-66 and 2003.“Despite all this, the kind of uproar that the Congress, Samajwadi Party, RJD and other parties have created over the SIR this time is extremely unfortunate,” he added.Maharashtra deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde also criticised the opposition over its demand for Kumar’s resignation. He alleged that Congress and its allies question the credibility of the Election Commission and EVMs after losing elections.“We are seeing what is happening. When the Congress wins in Telangana, Karnataka, Himachal Pradesh and Kerala, the Opposition does not comment on the Election Commission,” Shinde added.The political row comes amid continuing scrutiny of the Election Commission’s handling of the SIR. Opposition parties, including the Congress, CPI, CPI(M), Trinamool Congress and Shiv Sena (UBT), have demanded Kumar’s resignation.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi had alleged that the 2024 Lok Sabha and assembly elections were “all rigged” and demanded the immediate resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Union minister Kiren Rijiju said such remarks would send a “wrong message to society’

Article Title: Man slapped by Delhi minister Parvesh Verma was out on bail in MCD worker abduction, assault case
Article Text:
Delhi PWD Minister Parvesh Verma was involved in a confrontation with Sahib Singh over a newly laid road.





NEW DELHI: The controversy over Delhi PWD Minister Parvesh Verma slapping a man during a road inspection took a fresh turn on Monday after details of an earlier assault case involving the man emerged.Sahib Singh, 22, who was seen filming road work when Verma confronted and slapped him, had allegedly been arrested in a case registered at Tilak Nagar over the assault of a municipal worker, according to police records and documents shared by the minister.The case dates back to June, when MCD worker Dhan Bahadur alleged that he was assaulted after objecting to garbage being thrown from a building into a collection vehicle. According to his complaint, several men allegedly dragged him from the vehicle and beat him. He was taken to Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, where he underwent a medico-legal examination.A FIR was subsequently registered under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Bahadur later in a video said that Singh was among those involved in the assault. Singh has also been identified by the BJP as the man who allegedly abused Verma's family before the minister slapped him.The incident has triggered a political confrontation between the BJP and AAP, with AAP convenor Arvind Kejriwal likely to visit the area on Monday.
Article Summary: Delhi PWD Minister Parvesh Verma slapped a man during a road inspection. Sahib Singh, 22, who was seen filming road work when Verma confronted and slapped him, had allegedly been arrested in a case registered at Tilak Nagar over the assault of a municipal worker.

Article Title: Hyderabad shocker: Man kills wife with pestle after dispute, surrenders before police
Article Text:
Narender, a 25-year-old man, reportedly killed his wife Teja Sri at their home in Baglingampalli





HYDERABAD: A 25-year-old man allegedly killed his wife by attacking her with a pestle at their residence in Baglingampalli on Sunday. The accused was identified as Narender, an accountant at a hotel in RTC Crossroads.According to police officials, Narender married Teja Sri about five years ago. However, their relationship had become strained. On Sunday, the couple had an argument, following which Narender, allegedly in a fit of rage, attacked Teja Sri on the head with a pestle. She died on the spot. Later, Narender went to the police station and surrendered.Police reached the spot and shifted the body to Gandhi Hospital for postmortem. Forensic experts were called to the scene to collect evidence. Police registered a murder case against Narender.

Article Title: Road inspection, Rs 50L extortion claim and a slap by deputy CM: What led to political slugfest in Delhi
Article Text:
Deputy Chief Minister Parvesh Verma was involved in an incident where he slapped an aide of AAP MLA Jarnail Singh





NEW DELHI: Delhi's deputy CM and PWD minister Parvesh Verma slapped an aide of AAP MLA Jarnail Singh during a confrontation over a newly built road in west Delhi's Vikaspuri on Sunday, after AAP workers alleged the road was breaking apart.A video of the incident showed Verma inspecting the road when Jarnail Singh and other AAP workers arrived to question its quality. They peeled off the bitumen layer, with Jarnail alleging it came off "like a carpet".Sahib Singh, who later identified himself as the MLA's social media handler, was seen walking alongside Verma and recording the inspection on his phone. As Singh moved closer, the minister reached towards the phone, apparently trying to move it away from his face, before slapping him.Police have detained AAP MLA Kuldeep Kumar and party workers who protested demanding Verma's arrest.Oye maar kaise raha hai (How are you hitting?),” a man can be heard saying in the video. The minister’s security men subsequently moved him away.AAP protested against what it described as the minister’s misbehaviour and demanded his arrest.Minister Verma, in his defence, released a video. He alleged: “Road construction work has been under way on Vikaspuri Ring Road for the past several days.The local MLA, Jarnail Singh, had been pressuring PWD engineers to introduce him to the contractor and arrange for a commission for him. Our engineer has lodged a complaint at the police station and is getting an FIR registered. Because Jarnail Singh did not receive any commission, he would go to the site in the morning after the road was laid at night and tear it up; he would then record and post videos claiming that corruption was taking place. ”He added, “When Jarnail Singh arrived, he came with his own workers who had been informed in advance, and he immediately began behaving rudely. When one of his workers started hurling abuses at my family, I reacted just as anyone would in the heat of the moment. I want to tell AAP that our govt is doing today what yours failed to accomplish; that is why it is causing you such heartburn.”Dismissing the minister’s allegations, AAP MLA Jarnail Singh said, “I thought he would inspect the road, check the quality, and perhaps take action against the PWD officials. When I showed him how the entire road surface was peeling off like a carpet, instead of taking action, he slapped the person who was recording the incident and fled the scene. We have called the emergency number—112—to report this.”He said SHO of Vikaspuri Police Station was present when this incident occurred and demanded that Delhi Police Commissioner take action against the minister. Police said two complaints have been filed. One was filed by the private road contractor alleging the MLA’s demand for Rs 50 lakh and threats, and another by Sahib Singh against the minister for the assault. Police said they are probing the two complaints, and no FIR has been registered. Sahib Singh said, “His security personnel held my hand and grabbed me by the neck, trying to press it, and pulled me away. Three-four BJP workers were also with him. They also misbehaved with me and threatened to kill me.”Sahib Singh is presently out on bail after being arrested in a case against him for assaulting an MCD employee in June, police said. AAP national convener Arvind Kejriwal condemned the incident. He said, “A minister of Modi ji slapped a young man publicly for exposing corruption in road construction. I will go to Tilak Nagar tomorrow and inspect this road.”
Article Summary: Delhi's deputy CM and PWD minister Parvesh Verma slapped an aide of AAP MLA Jarnail Singh. Incident occurred during a confrontation over a newly built road in west Delhi's Vikaspuri. A video of the incident showed Verma inspecting the road when Singh and other AAP workers arrived to question its quality. They peeled off the bitumen layer, with Singh alleging it came off "like a carpet"

Article Text:
New Delhi:





A financial dispute turned fatal for a 28-year-old man who was assaulted and smothered, allegedly by his wife, in west Delhi ’s Uttam Nagar on Sept 23. She was arrested.The wife, Zeenat, called up her brother at 12.37 am just after the incident and asked him to come to her house near Kheda Wali Masjid immediately. He then alerted police. Cops rushed to the spot and found Akbar Ali lying in a pool of blood. A hammer was found by his side.Cops and forensics teams inspected the spot, after which the body was sent for post-mortem.During interrogation, Zeenat revealed that an argument had broken out at night between her and Akbar, following which she hit him with the hammer, police said. When he collapsed, Zeenat smothered his face with a pillow, leading to his death. The dispute allegedly arose over outstanding loans and unemployment of Akbar, who lost his job as a tailor 15 to 20 days ago.Zeenat and Akbar had been married for the past eight years. She has two daughters. Following the post-mortem report, Zeenat was arrested and a case under sections relating to murder under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita was registered. Further investigation is in progress.
Article Summary: A financial dispute turned fatal for a 28-year-old man who was assaulted and smothered, allegedly by his wife. The wife, Zeenat, called up her brother at 12.37 am just after the incident and asked him to come to her house near Kheda Wali Masjid. He then alerted police. Cops rushed to the spot and found Akbar Ali lying in a pool of blood. A hammer was found by his side.

Article Title: Congress to meet BMC over slum demolition in Mumbai
Article Text: Mumbai: Mumbai Congress president and MP Varsha Gaikwad will lead a delegation of MPs, MLAs and corporators to meet BMC commissioner Ashwini Bhide on Monday, Sept 28, over the civic body’s decision to demolish around 39,000 slum structures measuring 14 feet or more in height.Congress has joined the opposition to the BMC move announced last week. The meeting is scheduled for 1 pm.
Article Summary: Mumbai Congress president and MP Varsha Gaikwad will lead a delegation of MPs, MLAs and corporators to meet BMC commissioner Ashwini Bhide. Congress has joined the opposition to the BMC move announced last week. The meeting is scheduled for 1 pm.

Article Title: Aaditya Thackeray seeks direct drought aid, CEC’s resignation during Marathwada tour
Article Text:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray on Saturday demanded immediate, direct assistance for drought-hit farmers. He also stepped up his attack on Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities, saying his resignation alone would not be enough.“Those responsible for vote theft should face criminal action,” Thackeray said.Thackeray began a two-day tour of drought-hit Marathwada on Saturday. He visited farms and villages in Dharashiv and was scheduled to travel to Latur, Hingoli and other districts.“Govt has declared drought in 268 talukas. But the question is when and how will the assistance reach farmers,” he said.Thackeray claimed farmers were facing an exceptionally severe drought. He also alleged that assistance announced after last year’s excess rainfall and under loan-related measures had yet to reach many farmers.He backed Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray ’s demand for a special session of the state legislature to discuss the drought, drinking water shortages, problems in industrial areas and unemployment.Thackeray urged political parties, social organisations and NGOs to keep politics aside and reach farmers directly with assistance.He also alleged large-scale irregularities in electoral rolls. Thackeray claimed around 30 lakh of Mumbai’s 1.3 crore voters were fraudulent and that evidence regarding 17 lakh allegedly bogus voters had been submitted to the Election Commission ahead of the civic polls.“Gyanesh Kumar only says ‘yes sir’ to BJP,” Thackeray alleged. He said merely demanding the CEC’s resignation was not enough and sought criminal action against those responsible for the alleged irregularities.Thackeray said opposition parties would hold a major agitation in Mumbai on Oct 2 over alleged electoral irregularities and issues concerning the country’s youth.Sena (UBT) politicians Sushma Andhare, Ambadas Danve and party MLAs accompanied him on the tour.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray demanded immediate, direct assistance for drought-hit farmers. He also stepped up his attack on Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities. “Those responsible for vote theft should face criminal action,’ he said.

Article Title: Cops on Ganpati patrol hit by speeding MUV on Thane-Belapur Road, driver flees
Article Text:
The incident took place near Digha pond on the Belapur-bound lane at around 12.20am on Monday.





NAVI MUMBAI: In a hit-and-run incident on the Thane-Belapur Road, a police constable and a woman assistant sub-inspector (ASI) were injured when a speeding MUV rammed into their motorcycle from behind while they were patrolling during the seventh day of Ganpati immersion.The incident took place near Digha pond on the Belapur-bound lane at around 12.20am on Monday.The injured cops were identified as constable Umesh Patil, 41, who was riding his personal motorcycle, and ASI Rashmin Magar, who was riding pillion.The motorcycle skidded after being hit by the MUV. Patil sustained injuries to his left leg, while Magar suffered bruises to her left elbow, shoulder and left leg.Acting on a complaint filed by Patil, Rabale MIDC police registered an FIR under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Motor Vehicles Act against the MUV driver. Police traced him to his residence in Ghansoli.Devidas Kathale, senior inspector of Rabale MIDC police, said, “As the accused MUV driver's wife is due to deliver in a few days, he will be summoned to the police station later and served with a notice under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.”
Article Summary: The incident took place near Digha pond on the Belapur-bound lane at around 12.20am on Monday. The injured cops were identified as constable Umesh Patil, 41, and ASI Rashmin Magar, who was riding pillion. The motorcycle skidded after being hit by the MUV.

Article Title: Speeding SUV hits bike in Vashi, 3 youths injured; driver traced
Article Text:
Accused driver of SUV Mahindra Thar escaping after accident





NAVI MUMBAI: Three youths riding a bike were injured after a speeding SUV allegedly hit them head-on near PKC Hospital in Sector 14, Vashi, in the early hours of Monday.The incident took place around 1am. The injured youths were initially taken to NMMC Hospital in Vashi and were later referred to Sion Hospital for further treatment.Following the incident, a biker passing through the area chased the SUV and recorded its registration number on his mobile phone. Police then traced the vehicle's owner and obtained his mobile number.During the investigation, it was learnt that the owner's younger brother had taken the SUV out for a joy ride. Police subsequently traced his mobile tower location to an area near the creek in Sector 12, Vashi, where he was allegedly hiding.He was detained and served a notice under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), following which he was released.
Article Summary: Three youths riding a bike were injured after a speeding SUV allegedly hit them head-on near PKC Hospital in Sector 14, Vashi, in the early hours of Monday. A biker passing through the area chased the SUV and recorded its registration number on his mobile phone. Police traced the vehicle's owner and obtained his mobile number. The owner's younger brother had taken the SUV out for a joy ride.

Article Title: Quack doctor detained in Maharashtra for practising medicine without registration
Article Text:
A 27-year-old quack doctor was detained by Panvel police after an inspection (Representative image)





NAVI MUMBAI: A 27-year-old quack doctor was detained by Panvel taluka police after a complaint was lodged by the medical officer of the Primary Health Centre at Ajivali village in Panvel taluka, following an inspection by health department officials at his illegal clinic in Kasalkhand village on Monday afternoon.The accused was identified as Noorul Huda Imamul Haq, who hails from West Bengal and resides in an MHADA building in India Bulls Township, Kon village, Panvel.Gajanan Ghadge, senior inspector of Panvel taluka police, informed that the complaint was lodged by medical officer Dr Sayali Mankar, 33, who inspected Haq's clinic in Kasalkhand village and found that he was an unqualified and unregistered medical practitioner allegedly practising modern medicine by posing as a doctor.He had been running the clinic and treating patients for the past one month, police said. The police seized medicines stocked at the clinic as evidence.Inspector Ghadge said, "We have invoked relevant sections of the Maharashtra Medical Practitioners Act, 1961, against the accused, which prohibit any person from practising medicine in the state unless their name is registered under the relevant statutory provisions and prescribe criminal penalties and fines for those who illegally practise medicine without valid registration. Under the law, the accused was served a notice under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), directing him to appear for inquiry when summoned and during the court proceedings. "
Article Summary: The accused was identified as Noorul Huda Imamul Haq, who hails from West Bengal. He had been running the clinic and treating patients for the past one month, police said. The police seized medicines stocked at the clinic as evidence.

Article Title: Disha Salian case: Father, lawyer seek police protection, allege threats from Sena (UBT) leaders
Article Text:
Ojha questioned Aaditya Thackeray’s ‘Y-plus’ security, saying those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

(With agency inputs)





THANE: Advocate Nilesh Ojha on Sunday said that Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection, alleging that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders.Ojha, who is representing Satish Salian in the case, said they have written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), the Chief Justice of India and Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis, seeking protection."The CBI FIR was registered, and a letter was immediately written requesting police protection for four individuals: Satish Salian, our witness Sameer Wankhede, myself, and Ashutosh Pathak, " Ojha told news agency ANI.Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray , saying those who brought the matter to light and allegedly faced threats had been left without protection."The letter clearly states, citing records from your Home Ministry and the Narcotics Bureau, that it is evident that Aditya Thackeray is involved in the drug trade. Furthermore, an FIR has now been registered against him regarding gang rape, murder, and a cover-up.Several other high-profile individuals and police officers are also implicated as accused in this matter," he said."We have already provided all prima facie evidence; the CBI has obtained everything necessary during the investigation to secure a conviction. Yet, the accused currently enjoys 'Y-plus' security provided by your administration. Meanwhile, those who brought this matter to light and those facing direct threats from individuals like Sanjay Raut were left unprotected," the advocate added.He further said that providing security was mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines, and alleged that their request for protection had not been acted upon.He further added, "Providing security is mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines. Yet, they failed to do so. Consequently, we compiled all the material and handed it over to the CBI. We also urged them to investigate the role of Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and determine why police protection was not granted.""We have given a copy of this to the CBI, along with Prime Minister Modi ji, the Home Minister, the Chief Justice of India, and the Chief Minister," Ojha said.Disha Salian was found dead in Mumbai on June 8, 2020. Her death was initially registered as an Accidental Death Report (ADR).Salian died days before actor Sushant Singh Rajput , whose death also led to a high-profile investigation and widespread public controversy.Bombay High Court directed the CBI to register a formal First Information Report (FIR) and launch a fresh probe.As the probe progresses, Satish Salian, accompanied by his lawyer Nilesh Ojha, has submitted a pen drive containing material they described as evidence related to Disha Salian’s death.Meanwhile, Aaditya Thackeray has denied the allegations and responded to the defamation notice issued by Satish Salian.
Article Summary: Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection. They allege that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders. Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray. He said those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

Article Title: PM classmate’s battle for land continues despite BJP MLA's exit, no possession yet
Article Text:
Asgar Ali Vora met the PM on Sept 8 and sought his intervention in the land disp­u­te





BHAYANDAR: Asgar Ali Vora, a schoolmate of Prime Minister Narendra Modi , continues to struggle to regain possession of his land after MLA Narendra Mehta’s company announced that it had relinquished the property. However, another developer is allegedly continuing to retain possession of the land.Vora, 81, had purchased around 2,810 sq m of land at Navghar in Bhayandar East in 1989. He has alleged that Swayam Builders and Mehta’s Seven Eleven Constructions took possession of the property in 2011. After pursuing the matter for nearly 15 years, Vora met PM Modi on Sep 8 and complained against Mehta.Following the meeting, Mehta relinquished possession of the land, while the municipal corporation also cancelled the construction permission granted to him.However, the land has allegedly not been handed back to its original owner. Instead, developers Mukesh Parekh and Mervyn Fernandes are allegedly continuing to retain possession of the property. Following a complaint by Shiv Sena, Navghar police have registered a non-cognisable offence against Seven Eleven Constructions, Parekh and Fernandes.
Article Summary: Asgar Ali Vora, 81, had purchased around 2,810 sq m of land at Navghar in Bhayandar East in 1989. He has alleged that Swayam Builders and Mehta’s Seven Eleven Constructions took possession of the property in 2011. After pursuing the matter for nearly 15 years, Vora met PM Modi on Sep 8 and complained.

Article Title: Maharashtra TET paper leak: 2 key accused arrested; 168 buyers on radar
Article Text:
Two key accused in TET paper leak case arrested

How the leak occured





BHIWANDI: Two key accused allegedly linked to 168 prospective buyers of the leaked Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) question paper have been arrested, nearly two months after police busted the racket, with the SIT now probing the wider network and possible transactions.The two — Pune-based govt employee Prakash Misal and Bihar native Ashok Shaw, who was staying in Delhi — were among the remaining prominent accused identified during the probe. Police said Misal was in touch with around 50 people who had shown interest in buying the paper, while Shaw allegedly maintained a list of 118 prospective buyers. The list was recovered from his Delhi residence.Shaw was arrested in Patna, Bihar, while Misal was arrested near Bhiwandi Naka on Sunday after police learnt he was planning to surrender before a court. Both were produced before the Bhiwandi court and remanded in police custody till Sept 23.The SIT has so far verified 18 of the 118 names on Shaw's list and found they were preparing to appear for the TET examination. Verification of the remaining 100 is underway.Police suspect Shaw was directly linked to Solapur-based coaching-class operator Prakash Pawar, who has already been arrested, and was also in contact with alleged mastermind Bijendra Gupta.Investigators are questioning Misal to determine the price at which he allegedly planned to sell the paper and whether any sale took place. Earlier, accused Kapil Dahiya, who had allegedly travelled to Pune to deliver the paper to Misal, told investigators he could not hand it over.Police had busted the racket two days before the scheduled examination, forcing postponement of the TET.DCP Pawan Bansod confirmed the arrests. ACP Sachin Sangle, part of the SIT, told TOI, "Their interrogation will help us establish to whom they intended to sell the paper."Last week, the SIT filed a 3,470-page chargesheet before the Bhiwandi fast-track court against those arrested earlier in the case.With Misal and Shaw's arrests, police said the two remaining prominent accused identified during the investigation have been apprehended. Further arrests will depend on findings from their contacts and financial transactions.
Article Summary: Pune-based govt employee Prakash Misal and Bihar native Ashok Shaw were among the remaining prominent accused identified during the probe. Police said Misal was in touch with around 50 people who had shown interest in buying the paper. Shaw allegedly maintained a list of 118 prospective buyers.

Article Title: VBA’s Prakash Ambedkar questions LoP Rahul Gandhi over lack of united opposition protest in ECI issue
Article Text:
Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi (VBA) party president Prakash Ambedkar

Pune:





Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi (VBA) party president Prakash Ambedkar has questioned why Leader of Opposition (LoP) in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi has not brought all opposition parties together for a joint protest over the ongoing Election Commission of India (ECI) issue, asserting that the matter is “bigger than any one party”.Ambedkar on Sunday said Rahul Gandhi’s decision to protest was welcome, but argued that the opposition should collectively raise concerns over the electoral process. Ambedkar was referring to Rahul Gandhi’s demand for the immediate resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, following reports of formal objections raised by other Election Commissioners over decisions related to electoral-roll management and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.Ambedkar said, “LoP is organising a protest on behalf of his party ( Congress ), and that is good. But this is an issue concerning the entire country. In such a situation, LoP should bring all opposition parties together. Why he is not doing this is a matter of research.”He highlighted that the opposition needs to unitedly raise the issue of alleged irregularities in elections more aggressively and urged Gandhi to invite all parties to join the protest.“Rahul Gandhi should invite everyone to join the protest to prove that he is loyal to the demand he is raising,” Ambedkar said, adding that a broader opposition mobilisation would give greater strength to the issue.Ambedkar cited the SIR of electoral rolls in West Bengal and Maharashtra to underline his concerns. He claimed that nearly 1 crore voters had been removed from the WB rolls on citizenship-related grounds and about 94% had subsequently returned to the list.In Maharashtra, Ambedkar referred to the exclusion of nearly 2 crore voters from the draft electoral rolls. The draft published after the SIR exercise showed 2.07 crore of the state’s 9.78 crore electors were not included at that stage. ECI has clarified that this is not a final deletion figure and that the omitted names include voters categorised as absent, shifted, dead, duplicate or others, with a claims-and-objections process available.Ambedkar claimed that a large proportion of voters affected by deletions belonged to minority communities, while the remaining voters include people who, according to his assessment, were unlikely to support the ruling party anyway.
Article Summary: Ambedkar said Rahul Gandhi’s decision to protest was welcome, but argued that the opposition should collectively raise concerns over the electoral process. Ambedkar cited the SIR of electoral rolls in West Bengal and Maharashtra to underline his concerns. He claimed that nearly 1 crore voters had been removed from the WB rolls on citizenship-related grounds.

Article Title: TMC won 15 seats with sharpest voter drop: Fadnavis on SIR row
Article Text:
Nagpur:





Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Sunday countered Congress ’ charge that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) benefits BJP, while pointing to West Bengal where Trinamool Congress (TMC) won in 15 constituencies that saw the sharpest SIR-linked drop in voters.Congress MP Rahul Gandhi had recently levelled allegations against Election Commission, saying elections are rigged. Fadnavis said Congress questions the integrity of polls only when it loses. “In West Bengal, there are 15 constituencies where SIR removed a large number of voters, and TMC still got elected there. There has to be some logic behind allegations,” he said.Fadnavis said Saturday’s joint news conference by India’s three election commissioners had exposed the narrative Congress built around a letter the poll panel sent to cabinet secretary. “The letter is not on any policy issue at all. It relates to an appointment made on deputation,” he said.He added that all three commissioners made it clear that every step of the process, including SIR, was a joint decision. “All decisions were unanimous, and there was no difference of opinion anywhere in this process,” he said.Gandhi had alleged that Form 6, the application form used to add new names to voter lists, was being misused. Fadnavis said, “ Supreme Court has validated the format in which Form 6 exists. To create a controversy over that same format is, in effect, to create confusion around the Supreme Court’s own order.”On the objection process, Fadnavis said, “Every political party has the opportunity to appoint booth-level agents. They have the right to raise an objection on every page of the voter list, on every name. If a name has been wrongly left out, you can object. If someone’s name has not come up, you can object.”On the “vote chori” (vote theft) charge Congress has raised over SIR, Fadnavis said, “No vote theft has happened. Rahul Gandhi’s brain has been stolen. I would request the Prime Minister that some committee be formed that can bring back Rahul Gandhi’s stolen brain and return it to him, so that he speaks in the country’s interest, speaks correctly, speaks the truth.”He accused Gandhi of targeting constitutional institutions one by one to build public distrust in them.State Congress’ senior spokesperson Atul Londhe hit back at Fadnavis over the charge of undermining the Constitution. “When Supreme Court said there should be a committee to select election commissioners, with the Chief Justice of India, the leader of the opposition and the Prime Minister on it, the court set up such a committee. But Narendra Modi changed that committee,” Londhe said.
Article Summary: Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said Congress questions the integrity of polls only when it loses. He pointed to West Bengal where Trinamool Congress (TMC) won in 15 constituencies that saw the sharpest SIR-linked drop in voters. Congress MP Rahul Gandhi had levelled allegations against Election Commission, saying elections are rigged.

Article Title: On Karur stampede anniversary, Udhayanidhi hits out at Vijay
Article Text: Madurantakam: Leader of opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin on Sunday alleged that chief minister C Joseph Vijay had not displayed any remorse for Karur tragedy even after a year.Campaigning for DMK candidate I Paranthamen in Madurantakam on Sunday, Udhayanidhi alleged that Vijay had ‘run away from the spot without any guilt or shame.’ He said Vijay eventually became the CM by 'deceiving people’ and was now duping voters once again in the bypoll.“Without even providing drinking water, people were made to wait for 10 hours. Because of his delay, 41 people died on the day in Karur. CM was a person who ran away from the spot without even an iota of shame or guilt,’’ Udhayanidhi charged.He charged that even after becoming CM, Vijay was adopting undemocratic means while blaming other parties. “CM accuses DMK of giving money to voters. But he pays money and buys MLAs. Now he has gone to the next level by breaking a party into two and does a wholesale purchase of an entire faction,’’ Udhayanidhi alleged.Raising the issue of women’s safety, Udhayanidhi said police attempted to cover up the sexual assault of a schoolgirl in Vandalur as a case of snake bite. “There is no safety for women anywhere. Just two days ago, a schoolgirl was sexually assaulted in Vandalur.Since CM was heading for an election campaign, police refused to accept the complaint from the student’s parents and registered a false complaint claiming it was a snake bite,” Udhayanidhi said. He said a differently-abled girl was also gang-raped when she was alone at home.He then charged that Vijay never responds to questions in the assembly. “I had raised 16 questions about law and order, including drug menace and murders. But after three days when he responded, there was no answer to any of these questions,’’ he said.
Article Summary: Opposition leader Udhayanidhi Stalin alleged that chief minister C Joseph Vijay had not displayed any remorse for Karur tragedy even after a year. He said Vijay eventually became the CM by 'deceiving people' and was now duping voters once again in the bypoll.

Article Title: Two held with 189kg gutka, 500g ganja in Coimbatore
Article Text:
The seizure was made during a vehicle check in Vadavalli on Sunday

Coimbatore:





City police seized 189kg of gutka products and 500g of ganja from a taxi during a vehicle check near Vadavalli on Sunday and arrested two men in connection with the seizure. Police also seized the car in which the contraband was found.The arrested have been identified as B Andrews, 41, of Madukkarai, and R Selva, 28, from Sivaganga district. They were apprehended when police conducted a vehicle check following a tip-off.The two were subsequently produced before a court and remanded in judicial custody. Police are investigating the source of the contraband and the intended recipients as part of the probe.
Article Summary: City police seized 189kg of gutka products and 500g of ganja from a taxi during a vehicle check near Vadavalli. Police also seized the car in which the contraband was found. The arrested have been identified as B Andrews, 41, of Madukkarai, and R Selva, 28, from Sivaganga district.

Article Title: Man, aides booked for assaulting dalit man over tank dispute
Article Text:
Alanganallur police have registered a case under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against a man and his associates for allegedly assaulting and hurling casteist slurs at a 46-year-old dalit labourer





Madurai: Alanganallur police have registered a case under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against a man and his associates for allegedly assaulting and hurling casteist slurs at a 46-year-old dalit labourer, who questioned illegal fishing and water channel encroachments in Podumbu village. This follows a direction from Madras high court asking police to act, based on a petition from Pon Marimuthu, 46, a resident of Gandhiji Nagar Colony Street in Podumbu.According to the FIR, on May 6 when PWD officials inspected the spot, Marimuthu objected to unauthorised leasing of fishing rights in two local tanks which allegedly fetched up to ₹15 lakh illicitly. He alerted PWD officials regarding water drainage and blocking of inlet channels leading to the local water bodies.Irked by this, the suspect, identified as Kumar, and his associates reportedly confronted him at a local farm garden. Marimuthu alleged that they attacked him, grabbed him by the neck, hurled caste-based abuse, and attempted to tie him up inside the farm.Alanganallur police registered an FIR on Sept 24 against Kumar and unidentified fishing leaseholders under relevant sections of BNS, along with sections of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act. Further investigation is underway.
Article Summary: Alanganallur police have registered a case under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against a man and his associates for allegedly assaulting and hurling casteist slurs at a 46-year-old dalit labourer. This follows a direction from Madras high court asking police to act, based on a petition from Pon Marimuthu.

Article Title: Man booked for defamatory remarks against Madurai MP
Article Text:
City police on Saturday booked a man on charges of posting derogatory remarks against Madurai MP Su Venkatesan on social media.





Madurai: City police on Saturday booked a man on charges of posting derogatory remarks against Madurai MP Su Venkatesan on social media.SS Colony police registered the case based on a complaint lodged by Ganesan, secretary of the CPM’s Madurai city district committee.Police said Sivaprabakaran of Madurai posted a video clip against the MP on social media on Sept 23.The complainant alleged that Sivaprabakaran made remarks intended to create religious disharmony and made derogatory statements concerning Meenakshi Sundareshwarar Temple.Police registered a case under sections 196(1)(a) (promoting enmity between groups), 352 (intentional insult provoking breach of peace) and 353(2) (spreading false information or rumours promoting enmity between groups) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Further investigation is on.
Article Summary: City police on Saturday booked a man on charges of posting derogatory remarks against Madurai MP Su Venkatesan on social media. Sivaprabakaran of Madurai posted a video clip against the MP on Sept 23. Police registered a case under sections 196(1)(a) (promoting enmity between groups), 352 (intentional insult provoking breach of peace) and 353(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

Article Title: Awareness event held on vanishing indigenous sheep
Article Text:
At an awareness meeting held in Kadayakkulam village, Ramanathapuram District, the Tamil Nadu Federation of Pastoral People’s Sangam highlighted the urgent need to conserve the endangered Ramnad White Sheep, a traditional indigenous breed once native to the Ramanathapuram region





Madurai: An awareness meeting for pastoralists was held at Kadayakkulam village, Ramanathapuram district, highlighting the alarming decline of the native Ramnad White sheep, a breed once widely distributed across the state.Local pastoralists and conservationists from the Tamil Nadu Federation of Pastoral People’s Sangam (TFPPS) gathered to honour Thirupathi, a traditional pastoral farmer from the village, for his dedicated efforts in preserving the indigenous livestock breed.Thirupathi was presented with the Best Livestock Breed Conservator Award, instituted by the ICAR-National Bureau of Animal Genetic Resources (NBAGR), which he was unable to collect during a ceremony in Delhi earlier this year. Rajiv Gandhi , TFPPS president, warned that the purebred Ramnad White sheep is currently on the brink of extinction. “Over the past three decades, some pastoralists mixed local flocks with larger Nellore sheep from Andhra Pradesh, which drastically diluted the native genetic pool. Today, official census figures fail to reflect ground realities, where purebred herds have virtually vanished,” he said. Local estimates suggest that only hundreds of purebred Ramnad White sheep are in existence across the state.“Preserving indigenous sheep breeds such as the Ramnad White and the critically endangered Katchaikatty is deeply tied to regional culture and livelihoods,” Gandhi said, calling for govt intervention and dedicated schemes to safeguard these livestock.
Article Summary: An awareness meeting for pastoralists was held at Kadayakkulam village, Ramanathapuram district. It highlighted the alarming decline of the native Ramnad White sheep, a breed once widely distributed across the state. Local estimates suggest that only hundreds of purebred Ramnads are in existence.

Article Title: Health camp at Madurai bench benefits 1,054
Article Text:
The camp was organised by the state health and family welfare department in association with the National Health Mission and the court. Blood samples were collected from 901 people on Sept 16, 21 and 22, while specialist consultations were held on Sept 24 and 25.

Madurai:





A total of 1,054 people benefited from a health camp conducted at the Madurai bench of Madras high court recently.The camp was organised by the state health and family welfare department in association with the National Health Mission and the court. Blood samples were collected from 901 people on Sept 16, 21 and 22, while specialist consultations were held on Sept 24 and 25.Nearly 20 specialist doctors and medical teams provided diagnostic services, clinical care and health evaluations to judges, registrars, govt pleaders, CISF personnel, state police officers, PWD officials and judicial staff of the Madurai bench.Justice A D Jagadish Chandira and Justice G R Swaminathan attended the event. National Health Mission director S Aneesh Sekhar and health department secretary Darez Ahmed were also present.
Article Summary: The camp was organised by the state health and family welfare department in association with the National Health Mission and the court. Blood samples were collected from 901 people on Sept 16, 21 and 22, while specialist consultations were held on Sept 24 and 25. Nearly 20 specialist doctors and medical teams provided diagnostic services, clinical care and health evaluations.

Article Title: Auto driver arrested for threatening, assaulting cops in Yercaud
Article Text:
Representative image





SALEM: The Yercaud police have arrested an autorickshaw driver on charges of assaulting a special sub-inspector (SSI) and threatening to kill the SSI and a woman police constable.The arrested auto driver has been identified as Yuvraj, 22, of Mundagampadi. Yuvraj, who was drunk, obstructed vehicles near a Vinayagar statue on Monday. Head constable D Thavamani, who was regulating traffic, intervened. Yuvraj abused her verbally.SSI Aaron Athirubaraj attempted to defuse the situation. “But Yuvraj tore my shirt, struck me on the chest and threatened to kill me and Thavamani,” the SSI said.Police registered a case against Yuvraj under sections relating to obstructing govt servants, assault and criminal intimidation. He was remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: The arrested auto driver has been identified as Yuvraj, 22, of Mundagampadi. He was remanded in judicial custody. Police registered a case against him under sections relating to obstructing govt servants, assault and criminal intimidation.

Article Title: Couple killed as speeding private bus hits two-wheeler
Article Text:
Kochi:





An elderly couple were killed after their scooter collided with a private bus in Kothamangalam on Sunday morning.The deceased are Jose Varghese, 66, of Urulanthanni, Kuttampuzha, and his wife Susan, 57. The accident occurred at Thundam Junction on Vadattupara Road around 10.30am, police said.As per FIR, the bus named Appoos was heading towards Bhoothathankettu from Vadattupara when the accident occurred. FIR says that the bus driver was speeding and driving the vehicle recklessly.Though Varghese and Susan were rushed to a private hospital in Kothamangalam, doctors declared them dead, the police said. Kuttampuzha Police registered a case for rash driving and causing death by negligence. The bodies will be handed over to the kin after an autopsy, the police said.In a separate accident, a 34-year-old man was killed and his six-year-old son injured after their two-wheeler was knocked down by a truck near Kuzhikkattukara Juma Masjid in Edathala on Saturday night.According to the police, Rameesh of Fort Kochi died on the spot while his son Ridan suffered injuries to his head, leg and hand.

Article Text:

Palakkad

:





A 38-year-old man was allegedly stabbed to death by his stepson following a quarrel while the two were consuming alcohol at Malampuzha on Saturday night.
